The Oldest Profession

November 21, 2026
Buy Tickets
FilmNikkatsu’s Golden Age of Eros

『㊙色情めす市場』
(Maruhi) shikijo mesu ichiba

4K Restoration. With its monochromatic pallor and flashes of chroma, Noboru Tanaka’s The Oldest Profession brings forth a cross of ATG and radical pinku sensibilities. Set in the forbidden expanse of Kamagasaki, Osaka’s poverty-stricken tract of slums, The Oldest Profession is anchored by Meika Seri’s turn as 19-year-old prostitute Tome. Tome’s restless days are spent surrendering to the urges of men within the district’s hopeless wasteland of railroad tracks, doyas (cheap hostels) and bars. Known during its production as The Annunciation—a biblical reference to Archangel Gabriel’s proclamation to Mary that she would bear a divine savior through virgin birth—Tanaka’s guerrilla-shot apostasy captures its subjects writhing in both agony and pleasure over the course of a sordid Osaka summer.

Dir. Noboru Tanaka, 1974, 83 min, DCP, b&w and color, in Japanese with English subtitles. With Meika Seri, Junko Miyashita, Genshu Hanayagi, Shiro Yumemura, Moeko Ezawa.

Part of Nikkatsu’s Golden Age of Eros
Nov. 20 – Dec. 6
